title: Paris opens probe into women staff being 'sidelined' during Hindu group's Eiffel Tower visit

article.title: Paris opens probe into women staff being 'sidelined' during Hindu group's Eiffel Tower visit
article.summary: Female employees at the Eiffel Tower were asked to step out of sight during a visit by a ​Hindu religious delegation at the weekend, according to union representatives, prompting a staff protest ‌and an investigation by Paris city authorities. A delegation of about 100 ​people linked to the Bochasanwasi Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha, or BAPS, made ​a private visit to the Eiffel Tower on Saturday. The spiritual movement later apologised for “any pain or inconvenience caused” by the incident. The September 5 incident angered staff and drew criticism from French politicians, with the Hindu religious group later apologising. The Paris monument reopened on Tuesday after being closed late on Monday following a meeting between staff and management.
